_comment: Local instance (gitignored). Schema and field explanations: models.example.json. Server URL comes from config/local-ai.json (server_url), falling back to http://127.0.0.1:8080; add "base_url" here only to override it.

Deep.notes: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B MoE, thinking on; reasoning arrives in message.reasoning_content. thinking_allowance is added to every case's max_tokens because reasoning tokens count toward it (without it, short-answer cases came back empty with finish_reason=length).

Dev.notes: Qwen3.5-9B, thinking off by default (no chat_template_kwargs sent). Set {"enable_thinking": true} here to test with thinking.

Quick.notes: gemma-4-26B-A4B-it UD-IQ4_XS MoE (n-cpu-moe 20), thinking off. Sampling from the Gemma 4 model card.

Muse.notes: gemma-4-26B-A4B-it UD-IQ4_XS MoE (same file as Quick), thinking off. Sampling from the Gemma 4 model card.

_readme: Worked example matching examples/8gb-gpu/model.ini. Copy to eval/models.json. Add your language codes to `languages` to enable language-specific cases (e.g. ["ro"]).
